title: Amendment – Board Policy – BP 3312 Contracts and Delegation of Authority

headline: Updates the Board policy on who may sign contracts, with two possible spending limits
summary: The Board is asked to amend Board Policy 3312 on contracts and delegation of authority. outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
